name: Stopping the Cycle
summary: Howin Kindfeather returns from a test flight with troubling news: Dragonmaw warlocks are enslaving a red dragonspawn. The Wildhammer will not let that happen again.

sections.title: At the Gates
sections.body: Howin asks you to face the subdued dragonspawn at the Dragonmaw Gates. He says the warlocks holding it down must be killed first, which should free it. Then you are to put the dragonspawn out of its misery. Howin expects you to bring friends; the Wildhammer will not let the Dragonmaw stand in their way.

faq.answer: Howin Kindfeather asks you to stop the Dragonmaw from enslaving a red dragonspawn.
A group of Dragonmaw warlocks is holding down a red dragonspawn and trying to enslave it.
The subdued dragonspawn is at the Dragonmaw Gates.

faq.q: What does Howin ask me to do?
faq.answer: Howin asks you to kill the warlocks holding the dragonspawn down, then put it out of its misery.

faq.q: Why does Howin say the Wildhammer cannot allow this?
faq.answer: Howin says the Dragonmaw are enslaving a red dragonspawn, and insists the Wildhammer will not let them stand in the way.
